query:
SELECT 'Total matches' as metric, COUNT(*) as value FROM match_history
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Total player stats', COUNT(*) FROM match_player_stats
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Min match date', MIN(matchDate) FROM match_history
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Max match date', MAX(matchDate) FROM match_history
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Season 1 matches (>=2026-02-19)', COUNT(*) FROM match_history WHERE matchDate >= '2026-02-19'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Pre-season matches (<2026-02-19)', COUNT(*) FROM match_history WHERE matchDate < '2026-02-19'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'NULL date matches', COUNT(*) FROM match_history WHERE matchDate IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Champions completed', COUNT(*) FROM match_scrape_progress WHERE status = 'completed'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Champions in_progress', COUNT(*) FROM match_scrape_progress WHERE status = 'in_progress'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Champions pending', COUNT(*) FROM match_scrape_progress WHERE status = 'pending'
